subject: Using a checkboxInput for display logic

messages.author: b555f01b0716fd66
messages.subject: Using a checkboxInput for display logic
parts:
I'd like to use the checkboxInput command in the UI file to change the plot type in the server.R file. However I'm getting the following error message when I use it in an if statement:

Error: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable

if (checkboxInput$histogramPlot == FALSE) {
      p <- qplot(TotalTime/60, data = subset(subset(x,Company == paste(input$company)),Gender != paste(input$variable,'')), fill = Gender)+xlab("Minutes")+ylab("Runner")+ ggtitle("Histogram")
      print(p)
    } else {
      p <- qplot(TotalTime/60,Name, data = subset(subset(x,Company == paste(input$company)),Gender != paste(input$variable,'')), color = Gender)+xlab("Minutes")+ylab("Runner")+ ggtitle(paste(input$company))
      print(p)
     }
